intro: Invisibility Liquor is a potent, alchemically infused brew crafted using rare Crystal Kelp Fronds found in Elwynn Forest. Designed to render its drinker unseen for a brief window, it serves as the linchpin in a clandestine plot allowing two star-crossed young lovers to bypass their feuding families.

p: The ongoing feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures makes peaceful contact between their households nearly impossible. When young Tommy Joe Stonefield seeks to meet with Maybell Maclure away from the watchful eyes of their kin, conventional secrecy falls short. Invisibility Liquor provides an uncanny solution: an alcoholic draught that bends sight around the imbiber, granting just enough stealth to slip across disputed farmland undetected.
